title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
shortDescription: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six is organized in GameAtlas's Nintendo 64 shooter and strategy collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced shooter and strategy option to the Nintendo 64 discovery path.
